entities.name: American Revolution
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The colonial revolt (1765–1783) in which thirteen British colonies in North America won independence and established the United States. Inspired by Enlightenment ideals, it produced the Declaration of Independence and the US Constitution, becoming a model for democratic revolutions worldwide.
